description: Property inputs on a writable copy of the empty ACCDB. Database.CreateProperty + Properties.Append is called with Null, Empty, empty BSTR, empty byte array, zero, False, noncanonical Boolean inputs (I2 1, I4 -2, text), cross-type values, a Missing and an omitted Value, an empty name, a duplicate name, an undefined type code 99, 64- and 65-character names, and once with only a name. Properties are then enumerated (Name, Type, Value), and enumerated again after Close and reopen.
